# R5c evals — Wizard matches the approved canvas

> Base for every diff is the literal `$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5c.md)` (shell substitutes it). Run from the worktree root under bash or zsh. Written from spec R5c.1 to R5c.8, not from builder code. No database, no paid API, localhost only. Do not print `.env*`.
>
> Playwright always: `KV_E2E_PORT=3313 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts e2e/real-screens.spec.ts ...`.
> Shorthand: `D=src/components/covers`, `A=$D/AddCoverView.tsx`, `W=$D/wizard-copy.ts`, `C=$D/wizard.module.css`, `T=tests/components/kv-wizard.test.tsx`.

R5c-01. Scope: only R5c.1 rows or tests — cmd: `{ git diff --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5c.md); git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep . | grep -vE '^(src/components/covers/(WizardArt\.tsx|AddCoverView\.tsx|wizard-copy\.ts|PeopleStep\.tsx|wizard\.module\.css)|src/adapters/real-policy\.ts|tests/.*)$'; echo "stray-done"` — expect: no line before `stray-done` — PASS if every changed or untracked path is a listed row or under `tests/`.

R5c-02. Not-edited files unchanged, adapters diff minimal — cmd: `B=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5c.md); git diff --name-only $B -- ':(glob)**/add-cover-flow.ts' ':(glob)**/pay-flow.ts' src/lib/razorpay.ts src/components/shell src/components/ui e2e playwright.config.ts playwright.real.config.ts package.json package-lock.json src/styles src/components/public src/components/access; echo "unchanged-done"; git diff -U0 $B -- src/adapters | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)'; echo "adapters-done"` — expect: no line before `unchanged-done`; between that and `adapters-done` either nothing, or exactly one removed line containing `function toPolicyView` and one added line identical except `export ` before `function toPolicyView` — PASS if both hold.

R5c-03. WizardArt.tsx contract — cmd: `F=src/components/covers/WizardArt.tsx; test -f $F || echo MISSING-FILE; for s in 'export function WizardArt' '"doc"' '"family"' '"pay"' 'aria-hidden' 'viewBox="0 0 320 240"'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $F || echo "MISSING $s"; done; grep -n '<animate' $F; grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b' $F; echo "art-done"` — expect: no line before `art-done` — PASS if the file exists with all strings, no `<animate`, no hex colour literal.

R5c-04. AddCoverView uses the new pieces — cmd: `A=src/components/covers/AddCoverView.tsx; for s in 'WizardArt' 'One quick fix' 'Added' 'data-testid="cover-facts"' 'toPolicyView' 'holdingsView'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $A || echo "MISSING $s"; done; echo "new-done"` — expect: no line before `new-done` — PASS if all six strings are present.

R5c-05. AddCoverView keeps R3b strings, ids, logic — cmd: `A=src/components/covers/AddCoverView.tsx; for s in 'Can Knowvia read your policy?' 'Yes, read my policy' 'Drop your policy PDF here.' 'Choose PDF' 'Which plan is this?' 'Your cover is saved.' 'Open my policy' 'See what we found' 'Add health details' '// FOR LEGAL REVIEW: the wording below is not final.' '// FOR LEGAL REVIEW: price and payment wording.' 'policy-type' 'schedule-input' 'pay-card' 'runPay' 'confirmPay' 'POLL_MS'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $A || echo "MISSING $s"; done; echo "kept-done"` — expect: no line before `kept-done` — PASS if every pinned string is still present.

R5c-06. wizard-copy steps verbatim, R3b guides kept, still plain TS — cmd: `W=src/components/covers/wizard-copy.ts; grep -qF 'steps' $W || echo "MISSING steps"; for s in 'Open the PDF' 'Type the password. It is often your date of birth or policy number.' 'Print, then Save as PDF' 'This makes a new copy with no lock.' 'Add the new copy here' 'Knowvia reads it straight away.' 'Any PDF viewer or your browser works.' 'This makes a clean copy.' 'Find the schedule: who is covered, the sum insured and the dates.' 'Print only those pages' 'Choose Save as PDF as the printer.' 'Add the smaller copy here' 'This PDF has a password on it.' 'That PDF is too big.' 'We could not read this one.' 'That did not go through.'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $W || echo "MISSING $s"; done; grep -nE "from ['\"]react|<[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*[ />]|</" $W; echo "copy-done"` — expect: no line before `copy-done` — PASS if all strings are present and no React import or JSX appears.

R5c-07. PeopleStep uses family art — cmd: `P=src/components/covers/PeopleStep.tsx; grep -qF 'WizardArt' $P || echo "MISSING WizardArt"; grep -qE 'kind=("family"|\{"family"\})' $P || echo "MISSING family kind"; echo "people-done"` — expect: no line before `people-done` — PASS if `WizardArt` is used with kind `family`.

R5c-08. CSS layout pins — cmd: `C=src/components/covers/wizard.module.css; for s in '.split' 'minmax(0, 5fr) minmax(0, 7fr)' '1144px' '@media (max-height: 720px)' '@media (max-width: 1180px)'; do grep -qF -- "$s" $C || echo "MISSING $s"; done; echo "css-pins-done"` — expect: no line before `css-pins-done` — PASS if all five strings are present.

R5c-09. CSS stays calm — cmd: `C=src/components/covers/wizard.module.css; grep -nEi '#[0-9a-f]{3,8}\b|box-shadow|gradient|backdrop-filter|blur\(' $C; grep -nE 'font-size: *([0-9]|1[0-5])(\.[0-9]+)?px' $C; grep -nE 'font-weight: *([0-9]|[1-4][0-9][0-9]|normal)\b|font: (300|400) ' $C; echo "keyframes=$(grep -c '@keyframes' $C)"; grep -c '@keyframes kvWizardPulse' $C; echo "calm-done"` — expect: no line before `keyframes=`; then `keyframes=1`, then `1`, then `calm-done` — PASS if no hex, shadow, gradient, backdrop-filter, blur, font-size under 16px or weight under 500, and exactly one `@keyframes`, named `kvWizardPulse`.

R5c-10. Unit titles 23 to 30 verbatim — cmd: `T=tests/components/kv-wizard.test.tsx; for t in 'the step bar draws a line between steps and ticks the done ones' 'find, reading, consent and pay show the document or payment illustration' 'reading shows the stage percent above the heading' 'a password-protected PDF shows three numbered fix cards' 'a too-large PDF shows the page-picking fix cards' 'a guide without steps still shows its fix line' 'the result screen shows the headline values that were read' 'the result screen shows no cards when the read fails'; do grep -qF -- "\"$t\"" $T || echo "MISSING $t"; done; echo "titles-done"` — expect: no line before `titles-done` — PASS if all eight titles appear in double quotes.

R5c-11. Exactly 30 tests, none skipped, none deleted — cmd: `T=tests/components/kv-wizard.test.tsx; grep -cE '\bit\(' $T; grep -nE '\b(it|test|describe)\.(skip|only|todo|skipIf)\b|\bxit\(|\bxdescribe\(' $T; git diff --diff-filter=D --name-only $(git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/build/evals/R5c.md) -- tests; echo "count-done"` — expect: `30`, then no line before `count-done` — PASS if the count is 30 and no skip marker or deleted test file shows.

R5c-12. Wizard unit file passes — cmd: `npx vitest run tests/components/kv-wizard.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-${pipestatus[1]}}"` — expect: output contains `30 passed` and no `failed`, then `rc=0` — PASS if both hold.

R5c-13. Whole unit suite passes — cmd: `npx vitest run > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-unit.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -8 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-unit.txt"` — expect: `rc=0`, summary shows no `failed` — PASS if exit 0 and no failed test or file.

R5c-14. Decisive browser check, zero findings — cmd: `KV_E2E_PORT=3313 npx playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts e2e/real-screens.spec.ts -g "wizard|pay|payment" > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-pw.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '^\s+[0-9]+ (passed|failed|skipped|flaky|did not run|interrupted)' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-pw.txt"; echo "findings=$(grep -c 'finding:' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-pw.txt")"` — expect: `rc=0`, one summary line `N passed` (N at least 1) and no failed, skipped, flaky, did not run or interrupted line, then `findings=0` — PASS if all hold.

R5c-15. Typecheck — cmd: `npm run typecheck > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-tc.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -5 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-tc.txt"` — expect: `rc=0` — PASS if exit 0.

R5c-16. Lint clean apart from layout.tsx — cmd: `npm run lint > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-lint.txt" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -E '^(/|\./|src/)' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/r5c-lint.txt" | grep -vF 'src/app/layout.tsx'; echo "lint-done"` — expect: `rc=0`, no file line before `lint-done` — PASS if exit 0 and no listed file other than `src/app/layout.tsx`.

R5c-17. No server left on port 3313 — cmd: `lsof -nP -iTCP:3313 -sTCP:LISTEN; echo "rc=$?"` — expect: no listing, `rc=1` — PASS if nothing listens on 3313 after the runs.
